pytest.policy: warnings fail; narrowly scoped locked-dependency import deprecations may be filtered explicitly; increases require an explicit CR and evidence

ruff.policy: net_new_violations_fail; all newly added or materially edited Python files must be clean; reductions lower the budget

last_reduction.method: safe autofix + curated structural fixes + explicit exact-path governance exceptions
last_reduction.note: zero means zero findings in the configured mutable lint scope; immutable M4 files remain byte-frozen and legacy behavior-sensitive exceptions remain exact-path/exact-rule ledgered
